_note: Single source of truth for provider templates and free-tier metadata. Auto-managed by scripts/update_free_models.py. Hand-edits to per-provider 'believed_free'/'model_reasoning'/'free_limits' may be overwritten on next scrape; edit template fields (display, base_url, key_hint, ...) freely. Both llmproxy/setup_wizard.py and config.example.json are generated from this file.
_disclaimer: Free tier status is best-effort. Provider free tiers change without notice. Verify with each provider before relying on free availability in production.

cloudflare-ai-gateway._note: A 401 'Unauthorized' from /models means the API token is missing, invalid, or under-scoped for this gateway (needs Workers AI access; if the gateway has Authenticated Gateway enabled it also needs a cf-aig-authorization header). The gateway proxies inference only and has no GET /models endpoint, so models are advertised from model_filter below rather than discovered.

anthropic._note: Reached over Anthropic's native Messages API (x-api-key + anthropic-version). llmproxy translates OpenAI ⇄ Anthropic, so OpenAI clients can call Claude and Anthropic clients (/v1/messages) can call any provider. Models are advertised from model_filter (no OpenAI-shaped /models endpoint).

gemini.key_hint: Get your API key at aistudio.google.com/apikey (free tier available)
gemini._note: Reached over Gemini's native generateContent/streamGenerateContent API (x-goog-api-key). llmproxy translates OpenAI ⇄ Gemini. The OpenAI-compatible 'google' provider above is an alternative; this entry uses Gemini's native protocol. Models are advertised from model_filter.
